highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.156.1 servicing release corrects Ganesh geometry and flush handling and Graphite clip-capacity accounting.
highlights_body: These native fixes retain Skia m156 and do not change the managed API.

bullets.detail: Corrects matrix-axis mapping for rounded-rectangle radii and ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths. Transformed corner radii are clamped to half the device-space bounds to prevent overlapping corners.
Keeps draw and flush tokens synchronized after an empty flush so atlas work from one flush is not treated as pending in a later flush.

Accounts for clips still needing recording without double-counting recorded clips. A draw whose full effective clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding render-step capacity.
